## Handout 8 — Brutus' Intercepted Raven Message {.unnumbered}

*Give when the party searches the watchtower hearth ash (Investigation DC 12, or active search of the tower). Tear the paper into 4 pieces beforehand. Hand them over separately — let players assemble the text themselves.*

<div class="handout-block">

<div class="handout-label">Handout 8</div>

*Fragments of papyrus, half-burned. They were thrown into the hearth before anyone could read them. Someone was in a hurry.*

<hr class="handout-divider">

<div class="fragment-text">...granary before dawn. Leave nothing they can use.
Cassia must not reach the vault. She knows the form.
Complete this before the god wakes and our window closes.
If the fort falls, burn what you cannot carry.
Rome will not mourn a frontier garrison. It will thank you.

                                         — G.C.B.</div>

<hr class="handout-divider">

<div class="torn-note">Three pieces are legible. The fourth is ash. The initials are intact.</div>

</div>

## Handout 9 — Fort Vindolanda Order of Battle {.unnumbered}

*Give during Scene 2 (planning window) when the party asks "what do we have?" Fold once. Hand it to whoever holds the highest rank in the vexillatio.*

<div class="handout-block">

<div class="handout-label">Handout 9</div>

<div class="military-block">

<div class="heading">FORT VINDOLANDA — DAY 6 OF SIEGE
Order of Battle and Duty Roster</div>

<div class="section">
<div class="section-title">Wall Assignments</div>
North Wall: Optio Gaius Felix + 8 men
South Gate: Centurion Varro + 4 veterans
West Wall (breached section): Auxiliary detail, 6 men
Principia: Legate's bodyguard, 4 Praetorians
Shrine and adjacent: Augur Cassia — do not reassign
</div>

<div class="section">
<div class="section-title">Supply Status</div>
Rations: 3 days at full / 5 days at half distribution
Water: Cistern at 60% — do not use south well (contaminated)
</div>

<div class="section">
<div class="section-title">Signal Code</div>
1 long  = fire
2 short = breach
3 long  = all to walls
</div>

<div class="section">
<div class="restricted">— DO NOT DISTRIBUTE —</div>
Supply tunnel exit: south ditch, third post east
of the water gate. Varro only.
</div>

</div>
